headline: SANTA CRUZ PFS: $3.5B NPV AT SPOT COPPER — Ivanhoe Electric Breaks Ground October; Arizona Mine Targets 2029 First Cathode at $1.47/lb C1
snippet: Ivanhoe Electric (TSX/NYSE: IE) published its preliminary feasibility study for the 100%-owned Santa Cruz Copper Project in Arizona on September 23, returning an after-tax NPV8 of $3.5 billion and a 30% IRR at current COMEX spot prices ($6.79/lb copper), or $1.5 billion NPV at the base-case $4.75/lb. Initial capital of $1.43 billion, C1 cash costs of $1.47/lb, AISC of $2.28/lb; box cut development begins October 2026 with first copper cathode targeted for 2029. At record copper prices and with refined copper tariff decisions pending in Washington, the study positions Santa Cruz as one of the highest-NPV domestic US copper projects currently in development.

headline: GOLDMAN: CHINA HIDES 75% OF ITS GOLD BUYING — Sovereign Demand Surges to 100t/Month in June; $4,900 Year-End Call Stands
snippet: Goldman Sachs Research published a September 23 note revealing that China's sovereign gold purchases in July were approximately 75% higher than official PBoC data disclosed, with the broader central bank sector accelerating to a seasonally adjusted 100 tonnes per month in June 2026. Goldman maintains its $4,900 per ounce year-end 2026 gold price forecast, arguing that multi-year structural de-dollarisation flows from central banks are more durable than previously modelled — and systematically under-reported. At the current price of $4,268, the bank's call implies a 15% recovery before December 31.

headline: 44.8m AT 1.22 g/t GOLD IN NEVADA — Blossom Adds Northwest Zone at Rosebud Heap-Leach; 4 Rigs Running; MRE Due Q1 2027
snippet: Blossom Gold (TSX: BGAU) released drill results from its Rosebud Open-Pit Heap-Leach Project in Pershing County, Nevada on September 24, with the South Zone returning 44.8m at 1.22 g/t gold (including 3.2m at 5.06 g/t), a separate East Zone hole returning 106.8m at 0.42 g/t gold from 74.8m, and a maiden Northwest Zone intercept of 18.5m at 0.20 g/t from surface — opening a third expansion front. Four rigs are operating with 11,585m remaining in the 2026 surface program; an underground infill program commences Q4 2026 and an updated Mineral Resource Estimate is expected Q1 2027.

headline: NEXMETALS: 7.55m AT 6.48% CuEq IN BOTSWANA — High-Grade Cu-Ni Trend Extends to 1.5km; Resource Estimate Due Q3 2026
snippet: NexMetals Mining (OTC: NEXM) reported drill hole SMD-26-219 at the Selebi Main deposit in Botswana returned 7.55 metres at 6.48% copper equivalent (2.70% Cu, 1.83% Ni) within a 13.50m lower zone at 4.21% CuEq, and a new visual intercept from SMD-26-217 intersected three mineralized zones across 38.65m — extending the high-grade trend to approximately 1.5 kilometres. The 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate is on track for completion before end of Q3 2026; Selebi is a past-producing mine whose cobalt and platinum group element by-products add strategic appeal in any copper supply crunch.

headline: 37.89m AT 5.29 g/t GOLD IN BC — Dundee Launches Shovelnose PFS With C$85M Earn-In; Exploration Ramps to 4 Rigs
snippet: Westhaven Gold Corp released drill results from the Shovelnose Gold Project's South Zone in southern British Columbia, with hole SN26-085 returning 37.89m at 5.29 g/t gold and SN26-086 returning 14.0m at 13.09 g/t gold, as the 35,000m resource infill program nears completion. Dundee Corporation — earning up to 60% via a staged C$85 million commitment — initiated a C$4 million sonic drilling geotechnical and hydrogeology program to advance the pre-feasibility study (targeted H2 2027); exploration drilling scales from one to four rigs at end of September.

headline: GOGOLD FULLY FUNDED FOR LOS RICOS SILVER BUILD — $284M Cash, No Debt, 150 Contractors On Site; Q2 2028 Pour Confirmed
snippet: GoGold Resources (TSX: GGD) confirmed that construction at Los Ricos South in Jalisco, Mexico is progressing on schedule after commencing in August 2026, with plant design 90% complete, all long-lead equipment (SAG mill, tailings filter, major plant components) ordered, and more than 150 contractors on site. The company is fully funded from US$284 million in cash — generated by the operating Parral Tailings mine — with no debt or dilutive equity required; underground contractor Cominvi mobilizes Q4 2026 and the first silver pour is reiterated for Q2 2028.

headline: GOLDSKY FIRES 3 RIGS AT BARSELE — 25,000m Sweden Gold Debut Since Agnico Buy-Out; Resource Open in All Directions
snippet: Goldsky Resources (TSXV: GSKR) commenced its inaugural 25,000-metre diamond drill program at the 100%-owned Barsele Gold Project in Västerbotten, Sweden on September 16, with Rig 1 already turning and Rig 2 mobilizing by end of September — and a third rig from Arctic Drilling Company starting October. The campaign is the first major program since Goldsky acquired 100% from Agnico Eagle, targeting the Skiråsen, Central and Avan zones where the Mineral Resource remains open along strike and at depth; the objective is an expanded resource estimate and maiden PEA.

headline: ANGLOGOLD LOCKS IN LAKE CAREY — $10M Deposit Paid Early to Matsa; $45M Balance to Follow After WA Ministerial Consent
snippet: AngloGold Ashanti exercised its Lake Carey Gold Project option ahead of the contractual deadline on September 22, triggering an immediate A$10 million deposit payment to Matsa Resources (ASX: MAT) with the A$45 million balance payable within 15 business days once remaining conditions — principally third-party consents and assignment of contractual access rights — are satisfied. Western Australian ministerial consent under state mining law has already been secured, clearing the principal regulatory hurdle. Matsa retains the majority of its Lake Carey position including the Fortitude North and Fortitude Gold projects.
